changelog:
Initial release of JSON Transformer for advanced JSON data manipulation.

- Supports querying, filtering, sorting, grouping, renaming, adding/removing fields, merging, and aggregation of JSON data
- Pipeline-style operation chaining enables complex data workflows
- JMESPath-style querying and flexible predicate-based filtering
- Includes file input/output and result persistence
- No third-party dependencies; runs on Python 3.8+
summary: JSON数据转换 - 查询/过滤/合并/重命名/聚合JSON数据，支持管道式操作和JMESPath表达式
